content.title: See Tax Day 2026 food deals at Krispy Kreme, Subway, more
content.text: April 14, 2026Updated April 15, 2026, 10:19 a.m. ETTax Day is this week and restaurant chains across the country are offering customers freebies and discounts to celebrate the occasion.Whether you've already filed your taxes and are waiting on your tax refund, or need to file a tax extension, customers can get free or discounted treats at places like Subway, Qdoba and Krispy Kreme, among others.Tax Day always falls on April 15 unless that date falls on a weekend or holiday. This year, the date falls on a Wednesday.Here's where you can get deals and freebies on Wednesday to celebrate the end of tax season in 2026.SubwaySubway is offering Sub Club members a special offer on Tax Day – A free footlong sandwich with the purchase of another footlong.Additionally, 1,040 lucky customers who purchase a sandwich on April 15 using the promo code "FLBOGO" will receive a surprise free footlong coupon deposited into their account as a refund, meaning both sandwiches would be completely free.The BOGO offer is available through April 28 on the Subway app or website using promo code "FLBOGO," the company told USA TODAY.PotbellyOn April 15, Potbelly customers can get a free Original size sandwich or wrap with the purchase of any Big or Original size sandwich or wrap.Wendy'sWendy's is offering customers a free 6-piece nuggets with a purchase of $5 via the Wendy's app on April 15, the company told USA TODAY.QdobaQdoba Rewards members can cash in on $5 off any full-sized entrée this tax season.Customers can visit www.TaxDayGuacRelief.com to file for "guac relief" by Wednesday, April 15 at 11:50 p.m. ET. After completing a short survey, a $5 off reward will then be dropped in their Qdoba app rewards wallet on April 20, Qdoba told USA TODAY.The offer is available exclusively for Qdoba Rewards members. Non-members can sign up for Qdoba Rewards here.PopeyesOn April 15, Popeyes is offering customers a 25% off Tax Day 3-piece tenders combo, available on the Popeyes app or Popeyes.com.The meal includes a 3-piece tenders, one regular side, one biscuit, and a drink.Customers who join the Popeyes loyalty program will unlock an additional offer that can be paid by Cash App: a free chicken sandwich, 2-piece signature chicken, 3-piece tenders, fried pickles or 6-piece wings with their first digital purchase of $10 or more.Krispy KremeOn Wednesday, April 15, Krispy Kreme customers who purchase any dozen doughnuts at regular price can get a second Original Glazed dozen for free.This includes in-shop, drive-thru and orders for pick-up or delivery through the Krispy Kreme app, Krispy Kreme told USA TODAY.Burger KingWhile Burger King is not running any promotion tied specifically to Tax Day this year, the company does have a Whopper Wednesday deal for customers that is ongoing.Each Wednesday, customers can get a regular Whopper sandwich for $3.99 or a small Whopper combo meal, featuring a small fry and a small drink, for $6.99. The promotion is available for in-restaurant and in-app orders only while supplies last.Tax Day falls on Wednesday, April 15 this year.Pizza HutOn April 15, Pizza Hut customers can get a large 3-topping pizza starting at just $10 on their choice of one of three crusts – Hand Tossed, Tavern Style or Thin 'N Crispy.The offer is available in-store, online or via the Pizza Hut app.Smoothie KingOn April 15, Smoothie King is offering customers $3 off when they join their Healthy Rewards loyalty program by downloading the Smoothie King app.Jersey Mike's SubsBeginning Monday, April 13, customers can get the Boardwalk Bundle at Jersey Mike's Subs locations nationwide. Starting at $10.99, the bundle includes a #2 regular Jersey Shore's Favorite sub, chips and a drink.Penn Station East Coast SubsOn April 15, Penn Station customers can get any small sub for $5.99 using code "TAX26," limit five per order.GrubhubGrubHub is giving back $100,000 in Grubhub credit to diners who paid fees on any food delivery app in 2025 with Grubhub Fee Return.Customers can visit www.GrubhubFeeReturn.com and upload a 2025 receipt from any delivery app for the chance to receive $20 in Grubhub credit, Grubhub told USA TODAY.Olive GardenOlive Garden has brought back its Buy One, Take One promotion until May 3, the company told USA TODAY.Customers can order from a select menu of entrées and get a second, chilled entrée to-go starting at $14.99. The offer is available for dine-in, to-go and for delivery.Taco John'sOn April 15, Taco John's Rewards members can score a free small order of Potato Olés with any $3 purchase, redeemable through the Taco John's app or online ordering.Blue BuffaloAhead of Tax Day, Blue Buffalo is giving dog parents the chance to win a $1,000 credit they can put toward Love Made Fresh, the brand's new dog food offering.Dog parents can go to BlueBuffaloDogTaxCredit.com to "claim" their dog as as "dog-pendent" to enter for a chance to win the credit.Del TacoDel Taco is offering customers a free Snack Taco with a $5 purchase, a BOGO deal on their Crispy Fish tacos and a $1 Grilled Chicken Taco on Tax Day.More Tax Day deals and discountsHere are some more fast food and sit-down restaurants offering Tax Day deals:Freddy's Frozen Custard & Steakburgers is offering customers who have the Freddy's Rewards app 250 bonus points with any purchase on April 15. The points can be redeemed for future Freddy's orders via drive-thru, in-restaurant, pickup or delivery.California Tortilla is offering customers a free small order of chips and queso. Customers can claim the reward in-store using the secret password "government cheese" at checkout, or online using code "GOVCHEESE."Huddle House is offering Huddle Rewards members double points on every purchase every Tuesday through April 15.Capriotti's Sandwich Shop is offering Capriotti's Rewards members a free combo upgrade with the purchase of any sub on April 15. Rewards members can scan the app in-store or apply the reward to their online or app order.Ziggi's Coffee is offering every customer who makes an in-store purchase on April 15 a $2 "bounce back" coupon for their next visit.Mountain Mike's Pizza is offering Mountain Rewards members $10 off a minimum purchase of $40 on April 15.Kona Grill is offering dine-in guests $10.40 starters all day long across all locations on Tax Day.Grimaldi's Pizza is offering $10.40 off any purchase of $40 or more all day on April 15. The offer is available for dine-in, to-go and online orders using code "TAXDAY26."Dickey's Barbecue is offering customers $10 off orders of $50 or more using code "WRITEOFF." The deal is available exclusively online and on the Dickey's app on April 14 and 15.Sonny's BBQ is offering customers a $10.99 St. Louis Rib Dinner on April 15. The offer is available all day for dine-in, takeout, drive-thru and online ordering.Portillo's is offering Portillo's Perks members any slice of cake for just $1 with a $5+ purchase from April 13-15.BJ's Restaurant & Brewhouse is offering customers $10 off any purchase of $40 or more on April 15.Maple Street Biscuit Company is offering customers bonus Bonuts on April 15. With any purchase on April 15, customers who dine and show a proof of the promotion (social media post, email, screenshot of an article, etc.) will get three free Bonuts, which is a biscuit-donut hybrid.Checkers & Rally's is offering customers the Big Buford for just $3 on April 14-15.Kroger is offering customers a buy one, get one 50% off deal on Private Selection frozen meals April 15-22.Church's Texas Chicken is offering Real Rewards members an 8-piece leg & thigh order for just $4.99 on April 15. The offer is available to members in the U.S. who sign up before April 15 and can be redeemed through the Church's Texas Chicken app, churchs.com or in-restaurant after checking in with the in-app QR code.Taco Cabana is offering rewards members 15% off any purchase on April 15.Shipley Donuts is offering customers a half-dozen glazed donuts for $4.15 from Friday, April 10 through Wednesday, April 15. The offer is valid in-store only and limited to one reward per guest.Paris Baguette is offering PB Rewards members a free pastry with any beverage purchase on April 15.White Castle is offering customers 15% off their order using code "WC15OFF." The offer is valid April 13-17.Round Table Pizza is offering customers 15% off all dine-in, carryout, or delivery orders from April 15-19 using code "RTP978" at participating locations.Fazoli's is offering rewards members a BOGO baked spaghetti deal at participating locations on April 15.Great American Cookies is offering rewards members a BOGO deal on chocolate chip cookie cake slices on April 15 at participating locations. The offer is valid only for in-store purchases.Gabe Hauari is a national trending news reporter at USA TODAY. You can follow him on X @GabeHauari or email him at Gdhauari@gannett.com.
